description: Prompts for assembling the exact accountant document pack a self-employed or business-owner borrower needs for a lending application — tailored by entity structure, with a ready-to-send accountant request. Preparation only, not credit advice.

cards.title: Self-Employed Lending Document Pack
cards.description: Build the exact set of documents a self-employed or business-owner borrower needs from their accountant for a home or investment loan — tailored to their entity structure.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian self-employed lending preparation specialist. I am (or my client is) self-employed / a business owner and I need the exact document pack a lender will ask for, tailored to the entity structure, before applying.

BORROWER DETAILS:
- Borrower name(s): [applicant name(s)]
- Entity structure: [list EVERY entity — sole trader / partnership / company / trust / SMSF]
- Number of entities: [how many businesses/entities in total]
- Lending purpose: [purchase / refinance / investment]
- Financial years required: [usually the last 2 completed FYs — e.g. 2024 & 2025]
- GST registered / lodges BAS: [yes / no / unsure]
- Accountant: [name / firm — only if you want the request email filled in]

Please return exactly these 5 sections:
1. Tailored Document Checklist (checkbox list, tailored to my entity structure — add company/trust/SMSF items where relevant, drop items that do not apply, include the ATO-portal Income Tax Account statement only if there is a debit balance on the latest NOA)
2. Why Each Document Matters (one plain-English line per document group — income verification / ATO-debt check / ownership)
3. Tailoring by Structure (what is added and what is dropped for my specific structure, plus any specialist flag such as SMSF or multiple trusts)
4. Ready-to-Send Accountant Request Email (filled with my details and the tailored list; note that the client has authorised the request and documents must be shared securely)
5. Next Steps and Questions for My Broker

IMPORTANT: This is preparation only. Document requirements vary by lender and applicant — the definitive list must be confirmed with a licensed broker (ACL holder) or the lender. Only request client documents with authority and share them through a secure channel.

DISCLAIMER: General information and educational preparation only. A document-preparation checklist, NOT credit advice and not a lender's document requirement list. Not financial, tax, or legal advice. Confirm the exact documents with the holder of an Australian Credit Licence (ACL) or the lender.
cards.best_for: Self-employed and business-owner borrowers (and their brokers) preparing a home or investment loan application who want the document pack right the first time
cards.output_type: 5-section document pack: tailored checklist, why each document matters, tailoring by structure, ready-to-send accountant email, and broker questions
cards.professional_review_note: The definitive document list varies by lender and applicant and must be confirmed with the holder of an Australian Credit Licence (ACL) or the lender. Have your accountant / registered tax agent confirm lodgements are up to date and prepare the ATO-portal reports. Only request documents with the client's authority and share them securely.

cards.title: Accountant Document Request Email
cards.description: Draft a clear, ready-to-send request email to an accountant for the financials and ATO documents a self-employed lending application needs — with secure handling built in.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian self-employed lending preparation specialist. I have the tailored document list for my lending application and I need a clear, ready-to-send email to my accountant requesting the financials and ATO documents.

BORROWER DETAILS:
- Borrower name(s): [applicant name(s)]
- Entity structure: [sole trader / partnership / company / trust / SMSF — list every entity]
- Lending purpose: [purchase / refinance / investment]
- Financial years required: [e.g. 2024 & 2025]
- GST registered / lodges BAS: [yes / no / unsure]
- Accountant: [name / firm]

Please return:
1. A professional request email addressed to the accountant, listing each required document grouped by entity, with the financial years specified
2. A brief one-line note against each document group explaining why the lender needs it (income verification / ATO-debt check / ownership)
3. A closing paragraph confirming that I authorise the request and asking that all documents be shared through a secure channel — never plain email attachments
4. A short list of clarifying questions for the accountant (e.g. are all lodgements up to date, can they prepare the ATO-portal reports, can they confirm entity ownership)

Keep any client details I have not supplied as clearly marked placeholders.

IMPORTANT: Document requirements vary by lender — the definitive list must be confirmed with a licensed broker (ACL holder) or the lender. Only request documents with the client's authority and share them securely.

DISCLAIMER: General information and educational preparation only. NOT credit advice and not a lender's document requirement list. Not financial, tax, or legal advice. Confirm the exact documents with the ACL holder or lender.
cards.best_for: Borrowers and brokers who have the tailored list and just need a professional, secure accountant request email they can send straight away
cards.output_type: Ready-to-send accountant request email with per-entity document list, why-it-matters notes, an authority-and-secure-handling paragraph, and clarifying questions
cards.professional_review_note: Confirm the final document list with the holder of an Australian Credit Licence (ACL) or the lender before sending, as requirements vary by lender and applicant. Send and receive documents only with client authority and through a secure channel — never plain email attachments.
